checks.name: Ensure the device code sign-in flow is blocked
checks.rationale: Failure to configure systems to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access

checks.name: Enable Conditional Access policies to block legacy authentication
checks.rationale: Failure to configure systems to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.

checks.name: Ensure multifactor authentication is enabled for all users in administrative roles
checks.rationale: Failure to utilize Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to authenticate local access for privileged accounts exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

checks.name: Ensure multifactor authentication is enabled for all users
checks.rationale: Failure to utilize Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to authenticate local access for privileged accounts exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

checks.name: Trusted IP-based named locations susceptible to spoofing
checks.rationale: Failure to treat all users and devices as potential threats and prevent access to data and resources until the users can be properly authenticated and their access authorized exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > Named locations

checks.name: Conditional Access policies in report-only mode
checks.rationale: Failure to use automated mechanisms to monitor, enforce and report on configurations for endpoint devices exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access

checks.name: Ensure 'sign-in risk' is blocked for medium and high risk
checks.rationale: Failure to expedite the process of removing "high risk" individual’s access to Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) upon termination, as determined by management exposes the tenant to: Improper assignment of privileged functions, Unauthorized access.

checks.name: Enable Identity Protection user risk policies
checks.rationale: Failure to expedite the process of removing "high risk" individual’s access to Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) upon termination, as determined by management exposes the tenant to: Improper assignment of privileged functions, Unauthorized access.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access

checks.name: Ensure that between two and four global admins are designated
checks.rationale: Failure to restrict the assignment of privileged accounts to management-approved personnel and/or roles exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

checks.name: Ensure two emergency access accounts have been defined
checks.rationale: Failure to use automated mechanisms to disable or remove temporary and emergency accounts after an organization-defined time period for each type of account exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.

checks.name: Ensure weak authentication methods are disabled
checks.rationale: Failure to configure systems to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > SMS > Disable

checks.name: Ensure the email OTP authentication method is disabled
checks.rationale: Failure to configure systems to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Email OTP > Disable

checks.name: Ensure Microsoft Authenticator is configured to protect against MFA fatigue
checks.rationale: Failure to implement Out-of-Band Authentication (OOBA) under specific conditions exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Microsoft Authenticator > Configure > Require number matching = Enabled, Show application name = Enabled

checks.name: Ensure system-preferred multifactor authentication is enabled
checks.rationale: Failure to utilize Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to authenticate local access for privileged accounts exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Settings > System-preferred multifactor authentication > Enabled

checks.name: Ensure authentication methods policy is fully migrated to the converged policy
checks.rationale: Failure to configure systems to provide only essential capabilities exposes the tenant to configuration drift where authentication method controls set in the unified policy are not applied to users still governed by legacy per-method policies.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Settings > Enable combined registration and set Migration to 'Migration complete'

checks.name: Ensure suspicious activity reporting is enabled for MFA prompts
checks.rationale: Failure to monitor information systems to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks exposes the tenant to MFA fatigue attacks proceeding undetected — users who deny a fraudulent MFA prompt have no mechanism to flag it for SOC investigation.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Settings > Report suspicious activity > State: Enabled

checks.name: Ensure Temporary Access Pass authentication method is enabled
checks.rationale: Failure to provide resilient multi-factor authentication methods limits the organization's ability to securely onboard users, recover accounts, or register phishing-resistant credentials without resorting to weaker fallback mechanisms.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Temporary Access Pass > State: Enabled

checks.name: Ensure Temporary Access Pass is configured as single-use only
checks.rationale: Failure to terminate sessions after a defined period exposes the tenant to credential replay attacks — a reusable TAP intercepted during transit can be used by an attacker before it expires.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Temporary Access Pass > Is usable once: Enabled

checks.name: No break-glass emergency access account detected
checks.rationale: Failure to use automated mechanisms to disable or remove temporary and emergency accounts after an organization-defined time period for each type of account exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Users > New user

checks.name: Conditional Access Policy Count
checks.rationale: Failure to enforce Logical Access Control (LAC) permissions that conform to the principle of "least privilege?" exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

checks.name: Enabled Conditional Access Policies
checks.rationale: Failure to enforce Logical Access Control (LAC) permissions that conform to the principle of "least privilege?" exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

remediation.powershell: Get-MgIdentityConditionalAccessPolicy | Where-Object {$_.State -eq ''enabled''}. Ensure policies are set to On, not Report-only

checks.name: Ensure Conditional Access Enforces Session Sign-In Frequency
checks.rationale: Failure to enforce session sign-in frequency via Conditional Access allows cloud application sessions to persist indefinitely, leaving inactive connections open and exposing CUI to unauthorized access if a session is hijacked.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Security > Conditional Access > New policy > Grant: require periodic re-authentication > Session: Sign-in frequency (e.g., 8 hours for standard users, 1 hour for privileged sessions)

checks.name: Ensure Administrative accounts are cloud-only
checks.rationale: Failure to restrict the assignment of privileged accounts to management-approved personnel and/or roles exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Users > New user > Create user (cloud identity)

checks.name: Ensure user consent to apps accessing company data on their behalf is not allowed
checks.rationale: Failure to define, document, approve and enforce access restrictions associated with changes to Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > Consent and permissions

checks.name: Ensure the admin consent workflow is enabled
checks.rationale: Failure to analyze proposed changes for potential security impacts, prior to the implementation of the change exposes the tenant to: Unauthorized access, Loss of integrity through unauthorized changes, Emergent properties and/or unintended consequences.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > Admin consent requests

checks.name: User consent restricted to verified publishers only
checks.rationale: Failure to mitigate the risks associated with third-party access to its Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > Consent and permissions > User consent settings > Allow consent only from verified publishers or block user consent entirely

checks.name: Ensure admin consent request has designated reviewers configured
checks.rationale: Failure to manage access to organizational assets by configuring appropriate reviewers for consent requests means application access decisions default to Global Administrators, violating the principle of least privilege for administrative review.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > Consent and permissions > User consent settings > Admin consent requests > Reviewers: Add designated reviewers (Application Administrators or Cloud Application Administrators)

checks.name: Ensure admin consent request sends email notifications to reviewers
checks.rationale: Failure to notify designated reviewers of pending consent requests means applications awaiting approval go unreviewed indefinitely, effectively blocking the admin consent workflow and pushing users toward workarounds.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > Consent and permissions > User consent settings > Admin consent requests > Notify reviewers: Enabled

checks.name: Ensure that guest user access is restricted
checks.rationale: Failure to utilize the concept of least privilege, allowing only authorized access to processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational business functions exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > External Identities > External collaboration settings

checks.name: Ensure guest user invitations are limited to the Guest Inviter role
checks.rationale: Failure to prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions to include disabling, circumventing or altering implemented security safeguards / countermeasures exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > External Identities > External collaboration settings

checks.name: Guest User Count
checks.rationale: Failure to revoke user access rights in a timely manner, upon termination of employment or contract exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Users > Guest users

checks.name: Ensure all member users are 'MFA capable'
checks.rationale: Failure to utilize Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to authenticate local access for privileged accounts exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Registration campaign

checks.name: Percentage of users without MFA method registered
checks.rationale: Failure to utilize Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to authenticate local access for privileged accounts exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Registration campaign > Enable

checks.name: Ensure the 'Password expiration policy' is set to 'Set passwords to never expire'
checks.rationale: Failure to enforce complexity, length and lifespan considerations to ensure strong criteria for password-based authentication exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

remediation.portal: M365 admin center > Settings > Password expiration policy

checks.name: Security Defaults Enabled
checks.rationale: Failure to uniquely identify and centrally Authenticate, Authorize and Audit (AAA) organizational users and processes acting on behalf of organizational users exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Properties > Manage security defaults

checks.name: Security Defaults Gap Analysis (CA Coverage)
checks.rationale: Failure to uniquely identify and centrally Authenticate, Authorize and Audit (AAA) organizational users and processes acting on behalf of organizational users exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.

checks.name: Ensure MFA Registration Campaign is enabled to nudge users toward stronger methods
checks.rationale: Failure to drive enrollment on stronger authentication methods leaves the user population overly dependent on phishable methods (SMS, voice) and increases susceptibility to AiTM proxy phishing, push bombing, and SIM-swap tradecraft.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Registration campaign > Enable and target All Users

checks.name: Ensure external users cannot respond to Microsoft Forms
checks.rationale: Failure to control publicly-accessible content exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Unauthorized access, Lost, damaged or stolen asset(s).

remediation.portal: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Microsoft Forms > Uncheck "People outside your organization can respond"

checks.name: Ensure external users cannot collaborate on Microsoft Forms
checks.rationale: Failure to control publicly-accessible content exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Unauthorized access, Lost, damaged or stolen asset(s).

remediation.portal: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Microsoft Forms > Uncheck "People outside your organization can share and collaborate on forms"

checks.name: Ensure external users cannot view form results
checks.rationale: Failure to control publicly-accessible content exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Unauthorized access, Lost, damaged or stolen asset(s).

remediation.portal: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Microsoft Forms > Uncheck "People outside your organization can see results summary and individual responses"

checks.name: Ensure Microsoft Forms phishing protection is enabled
checks.rationale: Failure to utilize antimalware technologies to detect and eradicate malicious code exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions, Privilege escalation.

remediation.portal: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Microsoft Forms > Enable "Internal phishing protection"

checks.name: Ensure respondent identity recording is enabled by default
checks.rationale: Failure to review event logs on an ongoing basis and escalate incidents in accordance with established timelines and procedures exposes the tenant to: Unauthorized access, Lost, damaged or stolen asset(s), Loss of integrity through unauthorized changes.

remediation.portal: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Microsoft Forms > Enable "Record name by default when new forms are created"

checks.name: Ensure Bing image and video search is disabled in Forms
checks.rationale: Failure to control publicly-accessible content exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Unauthorized access, Lost, damaged or stolen asset(s).

remediation.portal: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Microsoft Forms > Uncheck "Bing search and YouTube video"

checks.name: Ensure application control policies restrict unauthorized software
checks.rationale: Failure to restrict unauthorized software execution allows users to install and run unapproved applications, increasing the attack surface for malware, supply chain compromise, and policy violations.

remediation.portal: Intune admin center > Devices > Configuration > Create profile > Endpoint protection > Windows Defender Application Control

checks.name: Ensure automated device discovery and enrollment is configured
checks.rationale: Failure to configure automated device discovery and enrollment allows devices to connect to organizational resources without management oversight, creating blind spots in the inventory and compliance posture.

remediation.portal: Entra admin center > Mobility (MDM and WIP) > Microsoft Intune > MDM user scope: All or Some

checks.name: Ensure devices without a compliance policy are marked 'not compliant'
checks.rationale: Failure to establish and maintain an authoritative source and repository to provide a trusted source and accountability for approved and implemented system components that prevents assets from being duplicated in other asset inventories exposes the tenant to: Emergent properties.

remediation.portal: Intune admin center > Devices > Compliance > Compliance policy settings > Mark devices with no compliance policy assigned as > Not compliant

checks.name: Ensure device enrollment for personally owned devices is blocked by default
checks.rationale: Failure to configure systems to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services exposes the tenant to: Inability to maintain individual accountability, Improper assignment of privileged functions.

remediation.portal: Intune admin center > Devices > Enrollment > Device platform restrictions > Edit default policy > Block personally owned devices for each platform

checks.name: Ensure FIPS-validated cryptography is enforced on managed devices
checks.rationale: Failure to enforce FIPS-validated cryptographic algorithms allows the use of weak or non-compliant encryption, potentially exposing CUI and sensitive data to cryptographic attacks.

remediation.portal: Intune admin center > Devices > Configuration > Create profile > Custom OMA-URI > Add setting: ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/Cryptography/AllowFipsAlgorithmPolicy = 1

checks.name: Ensure Intune serves as authoritative device inventory with categories
checks.rationale: Failure to maintain an authoritative, categorized component inventory prevents accurate asset tracking and risk assessment, making it impossible to identify unauthorized devices or enforce policy consistently.

remediation.portal: Intune admin center > Devices > Device categories > Create category

checks.name: Ensure mobile device compliance policies require encryption
checks.rationale: Failure to require encryption on mobile devices exposes CUI and sensitive data to unauthorized disclosure if a device is lost, stolen, or physically compromised.

remediation.portal: Intune admin center > Devices > Compliance > Create/edit iOS and Android compliance policies > Require device encryption

checks.name: Ensure portable storage devices are restricted on external systems
checks.rationale: Failure to restrict portable storage on external systems enables unauthorized data transfer via USB and removable media, increasing risk of data exfiltration and malware introduction.

remediation.portal: Intune admin center > Devices > Configuration > Create profile > Windows 10 and later > Device restrictions > General > Removable storage: Block

checks.name: Ensure Always-On VPN Is Configured for Managed Remote Devices
checks.rationale: Without an Always-On VPN profile routing all remote device traffic through a managed access control point, remote endpoints may connect directly to the internet, bypassing organizational security controls and logging.

remediation.portal: Intune > Devices > Configuration profiles > New profile > Windows > VPN > Always On: Enable, Auto-trigger: Enable

checks.name: Ensure Removable Media Use is Blocked on Managed Devices
checks.rationale: Failure to block removable media on managed endpoints enables data exfiltration of CUI via USB drives and SD cards, and introduces malware vectors that bypass network-based controls.

remediation.portal: Intune > Devices > Configuration profiles > New profile > Windows > Device restrictions > General > Removable storage: Block

checks.name: Ensure VPN Split Tunneling is Prevented on Managed Devices
checks.rationale: Allowing split tunneling on VPN-connected devices permits simultaneous access to organizational systems and untrusted networks, creating a data exfiltration pathway and bypassing organizational security controls.

remediation.portal: Intune > Devices > Configuration profiles > New profile > Windows > VPN > disable split tunneling (route all traffic through VPN)

checks.name: Ensure WiFi Enterprise Authentication and Encryption on Managed Devices
checks.rationale: Failure to enforce enterprise-grade WiFi authentication (WPA2-Enterprise/EAP-TLS) allows unauthorized devices to connect to corporate wireless networks and exposes CUI transmitted over unencrypted or weakly-encrypted channels.

remediation.portal: Intune > Devices > Configuration profiles > New profile > Windows > Wi-Fi > set Security type: WPA2-Enterprise, Authentication method: Certificates

checks.name: Conditional Access policy coverage for SharePoint
checks.rationale:
Failure to use automated mechanisms to enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for:
 (1) Remote network access; 
 (2) Third-party Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS); and/ or
 (3) Non-console access to critical TAAS that store, transmit and/or process.
